cases.case: S, M, R, O, any required signature or G missing
cases.effect: No compilation/test launch

cases.case: Unenrolled/self-generated key signs a locally matching manifest
cases.effect: Matching hashes cannot grant approval

cases.case: Current Git commit signer supplied without independent role enrollment
cases.effect: Commit integrity supplies no issuer/reviewer authority

cases.case: Reviewer key used for owner decision, owner key used for reviewer, or same key assigned both roles
cases.effect: Distinct accepted roles required

cases.case: Valid signature reused under another purpose namespace or altered message bytes
cases.effect: No cross-purpose approval

cases.case: Signature corrupt, unsupported algorithm/certificate, unapproved verifier or check-novalidate substituted
cases.effect: No mathematical-only approval shortcut

cases.case: Duplicate/unknown/missing keys, noncanonical key order/number, whitespace, escape, Unicode, extra bytes or oversized input
cases.effect: Reject before map conversion or approval

cases.case: Source-stage S is unsigned, signed by an unassigned key, binds another commit/tree, has wrong scope, or its digest differs among M/R/O
cases.effect: Review recommendation is not owner acceptance

cases.case: M names C0 instead of final reviewed C1, wrong tree, amended test own hash, or changed frozen T03 file
cases.effect: No stale source approval

cases.case: Lockfile, one of four Cargo manifests, toolchain file, implicit targets or source inventory changed
cases.effect: Preserve graph and exact reviewed wiring

cases.case: R/O/G references conflicting manifest/profile/report/signature identities
cases.effect: Every reference must bind same accepted chain

cases.case: Not-yet-valid/expired approval, overlong validity or backward/unreliable clock
cases.effect: No skip or Boolean override

cases.case: Revoked signer/approval, stale status, epoch rollback or conflicting owner decisions
cases.effect: Refuse unresolved status; external register is mandatory
cases.gate: external pre-Cargo; identity rechecks signed context

cases.case: Previously consumed grant/nonce, substituted run ID or uncertain prior launch
cases.effect: Test-local file cannot prove global single use

cases.case: Only inputs-only O exists, no G; BUILD_ONLY used to launch executable tests
cases.effect: Input acceptance never grants execution

cases.case: Policy A certificate/manifest/signature/archive/signer/algorithm differs
cases.effect: Exact policy only
cases.gate: external pre-Cargo; identity binds authenticated observation

cases.case: Policy A evidence older than 24h, missing immediate pre-acquisition check, unavailable required status or acquisition without authority
cases.effect: No fetch or status guess as remediation

cases.case: Missing host/musl std, CRT, linker closure, image, SBOM or licenses; dummy all-zero digests
cases.effect: No GNU target/PATH fallback
cases.gate: external pre-Cargo; identity binds authenticated observation

cases.case: Mutable local tool matches one digest but full loader/library/provenance closure is absent
cases.effect: Executable hash alone is insufficient

cases.case: Guest environment variable or self-produced report claims expected image/tool identities
cases.effect: Independent actual observations required

cases.case: Unexpected Cargo ancestor config, rustup proxy, compiler wrapper, build script, dependency, PATH child or network attempt
cases.effect: Stop and retain attempt

cases.case: Source/tool/input changes after observation or build UID can mutate sealed inputs
cases.effect: No check-then-replace success

cases.case: Lease expires, status cannot be refreshed, or revocation is observed during command
cases.effect: Stop, preserve outputs, no automatic retry

cases.case: No tests discovered, ignored cases, changed expected names, identity target still unconditional refusal or failing codec regression
cases.effect: No empty/source-only executable pass

cases.case: Independent rebuild reuses prior outputs or hashes/ELF form diverge
cases.effect: No full T04 acceptance

cases.case: Command, linker, verifier or component executable supplies content-only artifact or omits required installed-reference fields
cases.effect: No executable selection by digest or ambient PATH
cases.gate: external pre-Cargo and identity binding review

cases.case: Two inventoried regular files have identical bytes/hash; the requested invocation names the unapproved path
cases.effect: Identical content does not grant another path

cases.case: Installed reference has expected bytes/hash but selects another inventory or wrong path/endpoint entry identity
cases.effect: Select exact entry by path and canonical entry digest

cases.case: Declared leaf-symlink target is changed, missing, cyclic, excessive, outside approved roots or absent from the exact chain
cases.effect: Reject the chain, preserve refusal
cases.gate: external pre-Cargo and launch custody check

cases.case: Actual exec path or argv[0] differs from the installed reference path, including a same-content wrapper/alias
cases.effect: No invocation substitution

cases.case: Named installed path has a symlink parent, or actual endpoint differs from declared resolved regular identity
cases.effect: No implicit directory traversal or target fallback
cases.gate: external pre-Cargo and launch custody check

cases.case: A valid accepted review snapshot is supplied to G.action_observation_sha256, even while M/R/O remain active
cases.effect: Never launch using review evidence as action preflight
cases.gate: external launch gate and identity binding checks

cases.case: Fresh valid action report is from another grant/run/nonce or another exact command/action scope
cases.effect: No borrowing current reports across actions
cases.gate: external launch gate and identity binding checks

cases.case: G is signed and its 900-second lease is active, but elapsed time since action preflight completion is 60 seconds plus one ns
cases.effect: Record terminal refusal of G/nonce; no launch or retry

cases.case: Required external clock-session field is present but reset, unknown, different or guest-selected; launch reading is before completion or checked arithmetic cannot represent elapsed bound
cases.effect: No timestamp-only or Boolean freshness fallback

cases.case: Review observation includes forbidden run/grant/nonce or other unknown fields
cases.effect: Reject unknown fields or wrong closed purpose before acceptance
cases.gate: external input-review gate and identity shape checks

cases.case: Review observation belongs to another review_id/reviewer/manifest/source/profile set
cases.effect: No fabricated or stale input-review evidence

cases.case: Signing or queue delay makes a previously fresh action report stale just before process launch
cases.effect: Freshness must be checked after signing/queue delay

cases.case: A terminally stale G is resubmitted after replacing its report or re-signing its old grant/run/nonce
cases.effect: Require new identities and a new action report

cases.case: Otherwise complete action report binds another M/O/R or source/profile set
cases.effect: No inconsistent chain or hash cycle

cases.case: A valid ACTION_PREFLIGHT_ONLY report is supplied to R.review_observation_sha256
cases.effect: An action report cannot replace review evidence

cases.case: An otherwise matching review observation was older than the accepted input-review age when R was issued
cases.effect: No stale review acceptance

cases.case: Action observation lacks run/grant/nonce or another required field, or contains an unknown future-G-hash field
cases.effect: No incomplete action identity or hash cycle
cases.gate: external pre-Cargo/action gate and identity shape checks

cases.case: All installed-reference fields are present but the named executable path is relative, contains noncanonical path components or requests PATH resolution
cases.effect: Only the exact approved normalized absolute path can be selected

cases.case: Attempt to invoke a newly generated test binary under M_build/O_build/G_build, even with an authentic successful B
cases.effect: No generated binary launch; require the complete new test-input chain

cases.case: Generated-input manifest names receipt/signature digests whose actual B or signature bytes are absent
cases.effect: No receipt inferred from file existence or local hashes
cases.gate: generated input review and launch gate

cases.case: B signature is corrupt, uses another purpose/key/role or was self-issued by the build guest
cases.effect: Only the enrolled reviewer build-result attestation can establish producer provenance
cases.gate: generated input review and launch gate

cases.case: Authentic B or Q/E binds another producer M/R/O/G, source, command, grant/run/nonce, input profile or output inventory
cases.effect: Reject inconsistent lineage
cases.gate: generated input review and launch gate

cases.case: Compiler failed, was interrupted, ran outside lease/scope, has ambiguous status, live descendants, incomplete audit or mixed stale outputs despite surviving files
cases.effect: No eligible B or promotion of any output from that attempt
cases.gate: result attestation and generated input review gate

cases.case: Test binary bytes/length or resolved endpoint differs from B/Q inventory after compilation or sealing
cases.effect: No changed binary launch
cases.gate: generated input review and fresh action preflight

cases.case: The same compiled bytes are moved or invoked at a path not covered by B/Q and the accepted test inventory/custody
cases.effect: No equal-content relocation authority
cases.gate: generated input review and actual launch gate

cases.case: Output custody is absent, writable by the build guest, broken, precedes producer termination or cannot be independently verified
cases.effect: No transition or launch
cases.gate: result attestation, input review and fresh action preflight

cases.case: M_test exists but fresh R_test or explicit O_test is absent; compilation R_build/O_build is supplied instead
cases.effect: Authenticated B never substitutes for new input acceptance
cases.gate: test grant issuance and launch gate

cases.case: G_test requests an executable or command not already in M_test execution profile, Q and exact child allowlist
cases.effect: Do not authorize newly discovered commands from a receipt
cases.gate: test grant issuance and launch gate

cases.case: Q executable provenance refers to B instead of earlier raw E, or E/Q contains a future receipt/test-manifest hash
cases.effect: No cyclic or self-generated provenance
cases.gate: result attestation and generated input review

cases.case: Generated-input executable role is a client/helper runtime stub or another unsupported generated command
cases.effect: Existing T04 test scopes only; no runtime activation
cases.gate: generated input review and launch gate

cases.case: One M_test combines outputs from different producer actions without one matching B/Q lineage
cases.effect: Use separate input-approval cycles for distinct producer receipts

cases.case: All canonical S/M/R/O/G records and distinct review/action observations authenticate; exact installed paths, source/inputs, current status, freshness and one-use action pass
cases.effect: Future positive fixture cannot establish operational keys
cases.gate: external gate then corresponding identity check

cases.case: Inventory contains two same-content files; the command invokes only its exact approved path with matching regular endpoint/inventory entry and empty chain
cases.effect: The other path remains unauthorized

cases.case: Action preflight is current at exactly the approved 60-second monotonic boundary with every other approval, status and custody check satisfied
cases.effect: Boundary acceptance conveys no execution authority here

cases.case: The same active M/R/O supports a later explicitly signed distinct G with new grant/run/nonce and newly observed action inputs
cases.effect: Retains input review while independently refreshing action observations

cases.case: Valid M_build/R_build/O_build/G_build succeeds; actual outputs are sealed and authenticated in B; a new matching M_test/R_test/O_test/G_test then passes unchanged F01/F02 checks
cases.effect: Same S may be reused; no implementation authority exists here

cases.case: Successful producer G is consumed and later naturally expired, but its authenticated historical validity/provenance and current status are verified and a fresh active test-input chain independently accepts its sealed outputs
cases.effect: Historical build permission is evidence, never reused as current execution authority
cases.gate: future provenance and current action fixture

cases.case: One successful producer action creates both explicitly expected test targets, and B/Q identifies both; new independently accepted M_test commands and separate one-use G_test actions select each exact executable
cases.effect: No predicted hashes or receipt-only approval
cases.gate: future generated input review and action fixture

result_rule: Retain concrete inputs, exact expected and actual diagnostics, test name, source identity and authorized profile for each executed case. Specified is not executed. Mixed boundary rows expand into exact positive and negative assertions. No mock pass authenticates human evidence or operational custody.
scope: Accepted R2 64 scenarios and 34 D03/D04 extensions; no operational authority
